title: Apify Store Trends output
description: One dataset row per actor (`row_type: actor`) and one per target bucket (`row_type: target`). Field reference is in the README.

results.title: Rows as JSON
results.description: Every actor row (actor, target, users_7d/30d/90d/total, runs_30d, fail_rate_30d, rating, reviews, price, notice, days_since_last_run, gap_signals, snapshot_at, delta) and every target row (target, hostility, actors, users_30d, leader, leader_share, leader_rating, leader_fail_rate, weighted_rating, best_rating, broken_actors, signals, delta).

resultsCsv.title: Rows as CSV
resultsCsv.description: The same rows flattened with dot-separated column names (`delta.users_30d_change`).

actors.title: Actor rows only
actors.description: Just the `actor` rows, the most used first.

targets.title: Target rows only
targets.description: Just the `target` rows, one per niche, the highest demand first.
